description: Decides how much of the requested integration matrix a pull request needs. .github/scripts/select-integration.py reads it. Every changed file is matched against these entries in order and the first match wins: `ignore` means the file cannot change what an integration run proves, `select` adds the listed lanes, and `full` forces the whole matrix. A file that matches no entry forces the whole matrix, so an unmapped path can only cost time, never coverage. The nightly run always covers everything, whatever this file says. A hot-core pull request (see hot-core-paths.txt) always runs the whole matrix. `{ns}` in a path captures one directory name and is substituted into `client`.

entries.reason: Shared by every integration lane: contract specs inherited by integration wrappers, shared fixtures and project files, and lanes with no per-namespace mapping.
Documentation, the browser Workbench, other-language clients, specifications, benchmarks and samples never run inside an integration lane.
An integration spec change is proven by the namespace that holds it.
